description: This file defines a static class 'AssetChildFlows' that encapsulates a variety of asynchronous methods for managing asset-related child resources within a larger asset management system. These methods provide CRUD operations, validation, hierarchy management, and mapping functions for assets, properties, mappings, input parameters, and related entities, typically involving database repository interactions, logging, and validation rules.

classes.name: AssetChildFlows
classes.description: A static class providing a suite of asynchronous operations for managing asset child resources such as status logs, additional IDs, properties, mappings, input parameters, and data values within an asset management system.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset status log entry for a specified asset after validating existence and date sequencing.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all status log entries for a specified asset, throwing if the asset does not exist.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset status log by its ID, ensuring it belongs to the specified asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific asset status log after validating existence and date sequencing.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates an additional asset ID record linked to an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional asset IDs for a given asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional asset ID record by its ID, scoped to an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID record.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset property record under a given asset.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches an asset property by its ID within an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property record.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific control device mapping by ID under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping record.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter entry linked to an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists all input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an input parameter by ID under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter record.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Establishes a parent-child input parameter mapping, with validation to prevent hierarchy cycles.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a child parameter under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping, ensuring no cycles are introduced.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping, enforcing uniqueness within an asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a reporting attribute mapping by ID within an asset.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping, ensuring no duplicate attribute combinations.

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF (Entity Framework) source mapping for an input parameter, with validation for non-empty set/table.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings, returning empty if input parameter not found.

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an EF source mapping with validation.

methods.name: CreateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput equation for an input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations for an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation.

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar linked to a throughput equation, validating relationships.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput scalars under an asset for a specific throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar record.

methods.name: CreateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Creates a data input value for an input parameter.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync
methods.description: Lists data input values for an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value record.
